definitions.explanation: A horse with a white coat. Often carries symbolic or romantic connotations in Japanese, as in fairy tales and legends.

examples.japanese: {白馬|はくば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}った→乗る：00511_noru⟧{王子様|おうじさま}。
examples.english: A prince on a white horse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{草原|そうげん}→草原：05035_sougen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{白馬|はくば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駆|か}けて→駆ける：14714_kakeru⟧いく⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The sight of the white horse galloping across the meadow was beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、{白馬|はくば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}った→乗る：00511_noru⟧{王子様|おうじさま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{迎|むか}え→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{信|しん}じていた→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I believed a prince on a white horse would come for me.

notes:
{白馬|はくば} refers to a horse with a white coat. In Japanese culture, the white horse carries strong symbolic and romantic associations, appearing frequently in fairy tales and legends as a noble or magical creature. The word can also be read しろうま; はくば is the standard Sino-Japanese compound form.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{白馬|はくば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}った→乗る：00511_noru⟧{王子様|おうじさま} (a prince on a white horse) is a common fairy-tale image in Japanese culture, equivalent to the English "Prince Charming" or "knight in shining armor."
